transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is that I'm having a lot of trouble at work. I work at a meat processing plant, and... I just keep starting my tasks, like the sanitation steps, the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and I somehow always leave out the last parts. I know my job depends on finishing everything correctly, but I just can't seem to follow through all the way to the end. It's becoming a really serious problem for me.
Did you experience similar difficulties with completing tasks or staying focused when you were a child in school?

Yeah, I did. My mom actually still has some of my old elementary school report cards, mostly from around fourth grade. They always said that I was bright, but that I needed constant reminders to finish my classwork and actually turn in my homework. I remember that I understood the lessons just fine, but I would always miss chunks of the instructions... unless the teacher stayed right close to me to make sure I heard them.
Have you noticed any difficulty with your actual hearing, such as struggling to hear people speak or needing them to repeat themselves?

No, my hearing itself is totally fine. It's more like... I'm just not absorbing the words. Like, when my supervisor gives me directions face-to-face, I'll stand there and nod like I'm following along perfectly. But then a minute later, I realize I only remember the first piece of what she said, and I have to go ask a coworker what she just told me to do.
Do these difficulties with focus and finishing tasks also happen in your daily life outside of work, such as at home?

Yeah, they do. Um, at home, it's pretty much the same thing. I'll start doing the dishes, and then halfway through, I'll walk away to put something in the fridge, and then I just... never go back to the sink. Or I'll start folding laundry and end up leaving piles of clothes on the bed for days. It's really frustrating because I want to get these things done, but I just can't seem to stick with it to the end.
Do you often feel physically restless, fidgety, or like you are constantly driven to be on the go?

No, not really. I don't feel like I have to be constantly moving or anything like that. I might tap my foot sometimes if I'm bored, but I don't feel restless or like I can't sit still. It's more of a mental thing for me, just trying to keep my brain on track.
